key_insight: PACT formally defines token-level credit with three axioms and uses that theory to improve actor-critic alignment in LLM reinforcement learning.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a more principled training recipe for post-training LLMs and agentic reasoning systems by correcting critic learning after policy updates.
method: Define token-level credit via Completeness, Prefix Consistency, and Neutrality.
Show how OPD, RLOO, and GAE relate to the same credit signal under this framework.
Train the critic with an Actor-then-Critic order plus importance sampling correction to better match the updated policy.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 72.87% average accuracy on four math-reasoning benchmarks and a 67.4% pass rate on SWE-bench Verified, beating PPO, GRPO, and SAO.
watch_item: The actor-then-critic correction may add training complexity and its gains could depend on reward quality and the stability of importance sampling.
paper_title: PACT: From Credit Assignment to Critic Alignment
